definitions.explanation: A railway or bus employee responsible for ticket inspection, passenger announcements, and ensuring safe operation.

examples.japanese: {車掌|しゃしょう}が{切符|きっぷ}を{確認|かくにん}した。
{車掌|しゃしょう}さん、この{電車|でんしゃ}は{東京駅|とうきょうえき}に{止|と}まりますか。
examples.english: Conductor, does this train stop at Tokyo Station?

examples.japanese: {車掌|しゃしょう}が{次|つぎ}の{駅|えき}をアナウンスした。
examples.english: The conductor announced the next station.

notes:
USAGE: {車掌|しゃしょう} refers to the person on trains or buses who makes announcements, checks tickets, and assists passengers.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
・{車内|しゃない}アナウンス (making announcements)
・{切符|きっぷ}の{確認|かくにん} (ticket inspection)
・ドアの{開閉|かいへい} (door operation)
・{乗客|じょうきゃく}への{案内|あんない} (passenger assistance)

POLITE ADDRESS: When speaking to a conductor, {車掌|しゃしょう}さん is commonly used.

RELATED TERMS:
・{運転士|うんてんし}/{運転手|うんてんしゅ} - train/bus driver
・{駅員|えきいん} - station staff
